streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream A contains substrate, solvent, and additive. Concentration 0.1 M from batch input. Flow rate 0.5 mL/min from Engineering Design Calculations Step 3.
From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream B is Hydrogen gas. Flow rate 1.12 sccm from Engineering Design Calculations Step 9 to ensure 1.00 equiv supply.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Substrate, solvent, and additive mixed before contacting catalyst and H2. Gas-liquid mixing required for hydrogenation.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas liquid stream A with N2 or Ar sparging to remove O2 (Chemistry Plan: deoxygenation_required=true).
Pass liquid stream through a packed bed reactor containing Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst (Heterogeneous catalysis requires solid support).
post_reactor_steps: Filter catalyst bed or use inline filter to remove Pd(OH)2/Al2O3.
Quench not required; reaction stops upon H2 removal.
chemistry_notes: Heterogeneous hydrogenation of N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol using Pd(OH)2/Al2O3. Acetic acid added to enhance rate. Flow chemistry addresses mass transfer limitations (gas-liquid) identified in batch. Packed bed reactor recommended for heterogeneous catalyst handling. Deoxygenation critical to prevent catalyst oxidation. No photochemistry involved.
